items.title: Little Polar Bear
items.description: The bestselling series of books about Lars, the Little Polar Bear, will soon be a movie from warner Bros. To celebrate, Lars appears in a range of titles and formats, based on his film adventures. Full color.

items.title: The Little Drummer Boy
items.description: An illustrated version of the Christmas carol about the procession to Bethlehem and the offer of a poor boy to play his drum for the Christ Child. Full-color illustrations. Copyright © Libri GmbH. All rights reserved.
